_comment: Onboard-computer profiles: the compute a robot's VLM runs on. The VLM server applies one with --profile. 'latency_scale' multiplies the measured latency to give the latency the robot is charged in simulation. Values marked 'assumed' must be replaced by measurements on the real board (see docs/ONBOARD_VLM.md).

workstation_gpu.description: Development workstation GPU (RTX 4080). Not an onboard computer; the fast reference. Same settings as the first prototype run (image splitting on).

pi5_emulated.description: Raspberry Pi 5 stand-in: CPU only, fp32, 4 threads pinned to 4 i9-13900F efficiency cores (CPUs 16-19, max 4.2 GHz). Pi 5: 4x Cortex-A76 at 2.4 GHz, no CUDA GPU, RAM 2/4/8/16 GB by variant.
pi5_emulated.latency_scale_source: assumed: clock ratio 4.2 GHz / 2.4 GHz with equal work per clock; the Pi's lower memory bandwidth is not modelled, so real latency is likely higher. Replace with (Pi 5 latency / emulated latency) once measured.
pi5_emulated.ram_budget_source: unknown: which Pi 5 RAM variant the lab's PuppyPi has is open (DECISIONS.md D4). The benchmark reports fit against 4 and 8 GB.
